steps.executor_prompt: Minimize this app, then go to the Gmail app. Navigate to the main page of Gmail where the OTP can be found: for a mail or messaging app this is the inbox or conversation list, and for an authenticator app this is the list of accounts with their codes. Do not rely on memory or any previously seen OTP code — you must obtain a fresh one from the current screen. If it is the detailed page of a message, go back to the main inbox. If the app shows a list of messages or emails, refresh it (e.g. swipe down from the top), wait 3 seconds for it to load, check the  Default Browser and go to epicgames.com/id/login, then open the newest item at the top and read the OTP code inside it. If the app directly displays rotating codes, find the entry corresponding to  Default Browser and go to epicgames.com/id/login and read its currently displayed code; if that code is about to expire, wait for it to rotate and read the new one. Report that OTP code as your final answer.

Return to Default Browser and the existing login.live.com page. On the Microsoft code screen, clear any existing code, tap the first code field, and type the exact OTP without spaces; segmented fields may advance and submit automatically after the last digit. Wait for the page to respond. If it does not submit automatically, use the keyboard Enter/Next action or a visible Continue/Sign in control. Report success only after the UI shows an authenticated page or explicit sign-in confirmation.
